title: Stopky
description: Stopky is a Minecraft mod that allows players you create tracks and race on them.
body:
![Stopky logo](https://stopky.teammotorcraft.eu/logo/stopky/text/svg/stopky_logo_w_border.svg) Stopky is a Minecraft Mod that gives players the ability to create tracks and make races on them. It was made to be used together with Immersive Vehicles and packs for it. But that doesn't hinder you from using it for instance for boat, horse or other entity races (but it's important that the player is the one on it, because the mod tracks the player not the entity). You can find more (like an FAQ or recommended maps to use) on [stopky.teammotorcraft.eu](https://stopky.teammotorcraft.eu/). The documentations with video clips on how to use it are on [stopky-docs.teammotorcraft.eu](https://stopky-docs.teammotorcraft.eu/). # Warning **The mod is in alpha because it wasn't planned as a public release in the beginning. It is also currently licensed as All Right Reserved because of it. The rewrite will have a more open license.** # AI as a Teacher The mod was partly made with AI as a Teacher, that means, it was used to teach me how to do certain things in Minecraft (like render a UI, render 3D things in the world or other stuff that would be hard to find on the internet for this old minecraft version). The mod **WAS NOT** Vibecoded! Nearly everything was made by hand and with my mind. Some parts were inspired by open source or source available code on the internet (mostly GitHub).
**A Team Motorcraft project. Made with love by Tim3Game.** ![Team Motorcraft logo](https://stopky.teammotorcraft.eu/logo/team-motorcraft/motorcraft_logo_white_small_w_border.svg)
